opportunities.name: Plan a city weekend trip and email the itinerary
opportunities.description: For a given city, date range and party size: look up the city on Wikipedia, check the weather on timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking.com, find activities on Viator, find a dinner table on OpenTable, save a summary note, then draft an itinerary email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.com, notes app, mail app
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {city} and open the city article to note its population
On timeanddate, search for {city}, open the city result and check the current weather/forecast
On Booking.com, clear the destination, type {city} and choose the matching suggestion
Pick the check-in {start_date} and check-out {end_date} dates in the calendar
Open the travellers selector, change adults to {adults}, then click Done
Click Search, open the chosen hotel ({hotel}) and view Info & prices
On Viator, clear the search box, search '{activity_query} {city}' and open the top result; repeat for each activity
On OpenTable, type '{city} {cuisine}' in the search box, set the date to {start_date} and click Let's go / Find a table
Open the chosen restaurant ({restaurant}) and note the time slot (e.g. 18:30)
In Notes, add the note '{city} {start_date}-{end_date}: pop {population}, {temp}, hotel {hotel} {price}, {activities}, dinner {restaurant} {time}' and press Enter
In Mail, fill To={recipient_email} and Subject='{city} weekend {start_date}-{end_date}', then write a Body that summarises hotel, activities and dinner
Send the email or discard the draft
